slots.label: Amulet
slots.crafting_note: Any magic amulet works as a crafting input. Keep ilvl 90+ (Hell Act 4-5 / Diablo / Baal) for the full affix pool when crafting.

presets.label: Crafting base (ilvl 90+)
presets.reason: Hell A4-5 / boss magic amulet - max affix pool for crafted (Caster/Blood) amulets.

presets.label: +2 Class + 10% FCR
presets.reason: +2 class (prefix) + 10% FCR (suffix) - legal magic combo and a top gamble target.

presets.label: +3 Skill Tree + 10% FCR
presets.reason: +3 skill tab (prefix) + FCR (suffix) - excellent caster amulet.

slots.label: Gloves

presets.label: +3 Jav/Spear + 20% IAS (Lancer's)
presets.reason: BiS Javazon gloves - +3 skill tab (prefix) + 20% IAS (suffix).

presets.label: +3 Bow + 20% IAS (Archer's)
presets.reason: BiS Bowazon gloves.

presets.label: +3 Martial Arts + 20% IAS (Kenshi's)
presets.reason: BiS Martial-Arts Assassin gloves; very high demand.

presets.label: +3 Passive / +20% IAS
presets.reason: Zon passive / niche skill-tab gloves with 20% IAS.

notes: Gloves cap at 20% IAS (of Alacrity) in BOTH magic and rare - 30% is not possible.
Crushing Blow / Open Wounds gloves are CRAFTED (Blood Gloves), not magic or rare. Faster Block Rate does not roll on gloves.

slots.label: Boots

presets.label: 40% FRW (of Acceleration)
presets.reason: 40% FRW is MAGIC-ONLY (of Acceleration); rare boots cap at 30%. Top movement boots / craft base.

presets.label: Crafting input (any magic boot)
presets.reason: Cube Blood/Safety boots need a magic base; higher FRW carries useful potential.

notes: FRW + FHR + tri-res boots are RARE (multiple affixes), not magic - check those under the Rare tab.

presets.label: +3 Skill Tree
presets.reason: BiS for many builds (+3 Fire Sorc, +3 Warcries Barb, etc.); circlet magic level lets it roll high.

presets.label: +2 Class + 20% FCR
presets.reason: +2 class (prefix) + 20% FCR (suffix) - premium caster headgear; Warlock demand very high in S14.

presets.label: 1-2 sockets + +2 Class
presets.reason: Sockets roll independently of affixes - Larzuk/socket on a strong +skills base.

slots.label: Shield

presets.label: Monarch 40%+ All Res (Prismatic)
presets.reason: Prismatic (all-res prefix) caster shield while farming a white 4s Spirit Monarch - transitional.

presets.label: Pala shield 40%+ AR + 2 sockets
presets.reason: Budget Paladin shield until a white 4s Sacred Targe / Vortex Shield.

notes: Magic shields cannot host runewords - only white bases work for Spirit/Exile/Phoenix.

presets.label: +3 Shape-shifting + 2 sockets
presets.reason: BiS Werebear / Werewolf pelt.

presets.label: +3 Elemental + FCR
presets.reason: Elemental Druid caster pelt (+3 tab prefix + FCR suffix).

presets.label: +2 Druid + 20% FCR
presets.reason: Strong all-around Druid pelt.

presets.label: +3 Warcries + 2 sockets
presets.reason: Warcry / Shout Barb BiS.

presets.label: +3 Combat Masteries
presets.reason: Passive Barb builds.

presets.label: +3 Bone / Summon / P&B
presets.reason: BiS Necro off-hand skill head.

presets.label: 2 sockets + +skills
presets.reason: Rhyme / Splendor / Vigilance budget off-hand (max 3 sockets on heads).

presets.label: +3 Fire skill
presets.reason: Fire Sorc melee/CtA switch (orb staffmod).

presets.label: +3 Lightning skill
presets.reason: Lightning / Nova Sorc switch.

presets.label: +3 Cold skill
presets.reason: Pre-Fathom budget cold switch.

slots.label: Dagger (Warlock mods)

presets.label: +3 Warlock main skill
presets.reason: Near-BiS Warlock weapon (white daggers gained Warlock staffmods in RotW).

presets.label: +3 Warlock skill tree
presets.reason: High demand for Abyss / Echoing Strike builds.

notes: Void / Ritual runewords use white 3-socket daggers (Fanged Knife) - keep magic daggers for skill mods.

presets.label: +3 Demon Binding
presets.reason: Endgame Summoner Warlock off-hand.

presets.label: +3 Chaos Skills
presets.reason: Abyss / fire caster Warlock.

presets.label: +3 Demon Skills
presets.reason: Summoner Warlock.

presets.label: 2 sockets (Vigilance base)
presets.reason: Transitional off-hand - white 2s grimoire makes Vigilance.

slots.label: Jewel

presets.label: 15% IAS + high ED
presets.reason: Top jewel - 15 IAS (suffix) + 30-40% ED (prefix). 15/40 is near-perfect.

presets.label: 15% IAS + all res
presets.reason: 15 IAS + resist jewel - excellent for socketed armor/weapons.

presets.label: 40% ED + max damage
presets.reason: Perfect ED + max damage jewel for melee/bow.

presets.label: 15 all res
presets.reason: 15 all-res jewel - rare and valuable for any socketed gear.

notes: Rainbow Facets are UNIQUE jewels (-5% enemy res / +5% skill damage by element) - always keep; tracked as uniques, not magic rolls.

slots.label: Charm (Grand / Small)

presets.label: Skiller Grand Charm (+1 tab)
presets.reason: +1 to a skill tab grand charm - universally valuable (Sorc/Pala/Warlock highest).

presets.label: Skiller + 35-45 Life
presets.reason: Skiller with high life (needs high ilvl - Hell Diablo/Baal/Nihlathak). Premium.

presets.label: Small Charm: 20 Life or res/MF/FRW
presets.reason: 20-life small charm (of Vita), ideally with a useful prefix (all-res / 7% MF / 7% FRW).

notes: Charms can only be MAGIC (never rare). Grand = skillers; Small = life/res/MF/FRW; Large charms are rarely worth the space.
